column1: # STAGE C1 INVENTORY, measured 2026-09-18 on 982fb2f. A MEASUREMENT, NOT A GATE:
# nothing in scripts/check.sh reads this file, and it asserts nothing. It is here
# because the roadmap that drove it is deliberately untracked, and a measurement
# whose only record is a hand-written page is the thing this tree distrusts most.
# THE SUBJECT: every production `fn` in the 27 files that carry a P0-family
# `SEC-*` tag, after three whole files were dropped because their `mod` is
# Spans come from scripts/c1_inventory.py, whose own header lists the five ways
# it was wrong before this ran. Reproduce the file list with:
# THE PREDICATE was written before the first function was read, which is the only
# defence against fitting the number to the threshold. DECIDES if the return or
# effect determines: D1 whether a gate was spent, D2 whether a secret became
# reachable, D3 whether a persistent record was written or deleted, D4 status or
# permission, D5 a predicate one of D1-D4 reads as its condition and that is not a
# comparison against literals. MARSHALS otherwise. A function two readers disagree
# about is DECIDES: the predicate must overstate the core, because understating it
# is the one way this measurement could lie in the programme's favour.
# WHAT THE NUMBER DOES NOT ANSWER, and this is the finding, not a caveat. §15's
# 5 000-line threshold names the core AFTER C1 item 2 extracts it — pure transition
# functions, effects returned as descriptions. This file counts the CURRENT bodies
# of functions that decide. Measured over them: 45.8% of those lines carry no
# executable construct (comment, lone brace, blank); 302 of the deciding functions
# call another deciding function, so the sum double-counts along the call graph;
# and five of them are `async`, which C1 item 2 forbids in the core outright. On a
# 63-function sample the decision itself is 39.7% of the code lines. The threshold
# question needs decision SITES as its unit, not functions, and that inventory has
# WHICH IMAGE. The count is flavour-blind, and two crates make that measurable:
# rsk-ui and rsk-display are `optional` in firmware/Cargo.toml and reach only the
# `display` build — scripts/check.sh asserts in as many words that they are absent
# from the default image. They contribute 74 functions over 908 span lines here,
# 35 functions over 610 of them in the core, so the default flavour's core is 12 916
# and the display flavour's is 13 526. A ratchet that does not name its flavour
# would read a feature flip as 610 lines of progress.
# COLUMNS: fn, file:line, span lines, label, rule, why, properties. `label` is
# after adversarial review, which moved 392 lines into the core and 215 out. The
# five rows review moved OUT carry rule `M` and a `why` beginning REVIEW:, with the
# argument it refuted named — they are the only place this file contradicts rule 1
# of its own predicate, and they do it on evidence rather than on doubt.
